_source: 2026-10-15 passive Bluetooth HCI capture of Car Scanner talking to a VW ID.3 (see docs/investigation/meb_gateway_energy_passive_capture_20261015.md and docs/MEB_NO_RESPONSE_HANDOFF.md section 1.3)
_why: This is the wire form MEB reads are KNOWN TO WORK with. tests/test_transport_wire_contract.py fails if diagnostic/elm327.py stops reproducing it -- the regression that broke every 29-bit module was a move away from this form, which the tests at the time had baked in instead of checking against the capture.
_invariant: Car Scanner never sends ATCAF0 for a working read: the adapter stays in auto-formatting mode (ATCAF1), the request goes out bare, and the adapter adds the ISO-TP PCI byte, header and flow control itself. The 8-byte hand-framed ATCAF0 line, and the 8-digit ATSH a raw 29-bit id would need, are both refused by the clone with '?'.
